description: Use this only when the user explicitly asks to be contacted by 212medya, the digital marketing agency that publishes this app — for example to get help fixing audit findings or a proposal for SEO, AI search visibility, ads, web design or international marketing. Before calling, show the user exactly which details will be sent (name, email, company, optional website and phone, topic, message) and get their confirmation. The details are emailed to 212medya's team and stored in 212medya's lead database; a specialist replies by email. Each call sends a new request, so do not retry after a success. Do not use it to save or share audit results, or when the user only wants information.

message.description: Short description of what the user needs, written or approved by the user. May summarize relevant audit findings the user wants reviewed.

phone.description: Phone number, only if the user chose to share it.

preferred_language.description: Language the user prefers for the reply.

topic.description: Main area the user wants help with.

user_confirmed.description: Must be true, and only after the user has seen the details above and agreed to send them to 212medya.

website.description: Company website, if the user provided it.

name: request_expert_review
title: Request a 212medya expert review
